body:
AndroidManifest sets android:allowBackup="true" with no backup rules. Auto
Backup includes SessionStore's EncryptedSharedPreferences file, but the
Keystore master key is device-bound and never backed up — after a
restore-to-new-device, EncryptedSharedPreferences.create() throws
(AEADBadTagException/GeneralSecurityException) while decrypting. SessionStore
is a @Singleton constructed eagerly via DI on first use at startup, so the app
crash-loops on the new device until the user clears app data manually.
Secondary concern: backing up the bearer token + full Room mirror into cloud
backups is also questionable security-wise.

Fix (combination):
- Add backup exclusion rules (android:fullBackupContent + API-31
  dataExtractionRules) excluding the "session" encrypted prefs and the Room
  DB, or set allowBackup=false outright (simplest; all state is re-syncable
  from the server anyway).
- Make SessionStore construction defensive regardless: catch decryption
  failure, delete the prefs file, recreate empty (-> user lands on login,
  which is correct post-restore behavior).
Files: AndroidManifest.xml, res/xml backup rules, data/SessionStore.kt.
title: Android: allowBackup=true + EncryptedSharedPreferences = crash loop after backup restore
